raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With the SHUFFLE 5D KV layout (`SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=vectorized_5d`), a dense model without sliding-window attention decodes garbage on the AITER backend: GSM8K drops from 0.955 to 0.010 on Qwen3-14B-FP8, with no error.

`forward_decode_vectorized_5d` passes `forward_metadata.kv_indices` to `pa_decode_gluon` as its `block_tables`, a 2-D `(bs, max_num_blocks_per_seq)` table of page ids, and its docstring says the same ("Full-attn → `kv_indices` page table"). But the decode metadata only builds that table on the unified-attention branch:

```python
if not self.use_triton_unified_attention:
    # flat per-token kv_indices, addressed through kv_indptr
    create_flashinfer_kv_indices_triton[(bs,)](...)
else:
    # 2-D page table
    ...
```

`use_triton_unified_attention` is forced on for sliding-window models, which is why gpt-oss (the model the 5D path was added for in #27063) is unaffected. Every other model leaves it off by default, so `pa_decode_gluon` reads token ids as page ids with a row stride of 1. The eager path, the CUDA-graph page-table buffer and CUDA-graph capture/replay all make the same choice.

## Modifications

The decode metadata format and the decode kernel are separate choices, so this PR names the former explicitly:

```python
self.decode_uses_page_table = (
    self.use_triton_unified_attention or self.kv_cache_is_vectorized_5d
)
```

and uses it at the five sites that decide between the flat indices and the page table: the eager decode path (plain and speculative), the CUDA-graph page-table buffer allocation, and both checks in `_apply_cuda_graph_metadata` (shared by capture and replay).

`use_triton_unified_attention` itself is unchanged. The 5D layout already has dedicated KV-write, extend and decode branches, so the only things the flag still controls for it are the metadata format and the target-verify kernel choice (`_use_unified_verify`). Forcing the flag on would also switch the verify kernel, which is outside this fix. The NHD layout is unaffected: `decode_uses_page_table` equals `use_triton_unified_attention` there.

Tests: `test/registered/amd/test_aiter_vectorized_5d_decode.py` launches the CI default model (`meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`, dense, no sliding window) with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, the 5D layout and `--page-size 64`, and runs GSM8K. Registered in `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X (gfx950, 256 CU), ROCm 7.2.0, torch 2.9.1, Triton 3.7.0. sglang `main` @ `c44a42e6d3` (no later changes to the touched files), `sgl-kernel` built from the same commit, AITER `e7d2453f` (the commit pinned in `docker/rocm.Dockerfile`).

Qwen3-14B-FP8, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `--page-size 64`, CUDA graph on, GSM8K 200 questions, 5-shot, greedy:

| Config | GSM8K | Output tok/s (warm) |
|---|---|---|
| `main`, NHD layout (reference) | 0.955 | 3594 |
| `main`, 5D layout | **0.010** | n/a (garbage output) |
| This PR, 5D layout | 0.945 / 0.940 | 3499 |
| `main`, 5D layout + `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` | 0.945 / 0.955 | 3581 |

The last row already builds the page table on `main` (through the unified flag), so it is the existing reference for the fixed path. This PR matches it in accuracy and throughput; the three servers ran concurrently on separate GPUs, so the ~3% spread is within noise.

New test, same environment:

| Code | GSM8K | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | 0.015 | fails (threshold 0.7) |
| This PR | 0.770 | passes in 204 s |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No change on the NHD layout. On the 5D layout the fixed path builds the same page table as the unified-attention path; throughput is in the table above.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #29009 (enables `pa_decode_gluon` for Qwen3.5-MoE) relies on the same page-table contract for `kv_indices`.

                 "SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN"
             )
 
+        # Decode metadata format. unified_attention and pa_decode_gluon (the
+        # SHUFFLE 5D decode kernel) both read kv_indices as a 2-D
+        # (bs, max_num_blocks_per_seq) page table; the remaining decode kernels
+        # read flat per-token kv_indices addressed through kv_indptr.
+        self.decode_uses_page_table = (
+            self.use_triton_unified_attention or self.kv_cache_is_vectorized_5d

+
         # When topk == 1 the EAGLE draft chain is linear, so target_verify's
         # mask reduces to pure causal and can go through unified_attention
         # instead of the legacy triton extend_attention_fwd. Gated on non-MLA
@@ -2054,7 +2062,7 @@ def init_forward_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
                 kv_indptr[1 : bs + 1] = torch.cumsum(forward_batch.seq_lens, dim=0)
                 kv_indptr = kv_indptr[: bs + 1]
 
-                if not self.use_triton_unified_attention:
+                if not self.decode_uses_page_table:
                     kv_indices = self._get_kv_indices_scratch(
                         forward_batch.seq_lens_sum, forward_batch.seq_lens.device
                     )
@@ -2119,7 +2127,7 @@ def init_forward_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
                     qo_indptr = self.qo_indptr_unified_decode[: bs + 1]
 
             else:
-                if self.use_triton_unified_attention and not self.use_mla:
+                if self.decode_uses_page_table and not self.use_mla:
                     bs = spec_info.kv_indptr.shape[0] - 1
                     kv_indices, swa_page_table = (
                         self._build_unified_page_table_from_spec(spec_info, bs)
@@ -2819,8 +2827,8 @@ def init_cuda_graph_state(
         else:
             self.cuda_graph_kv_indices = kv_indices_buf
 
-        if self.use_triton_unified_attention:
-            # Keep a distinct page-table buffer for unified attention.  Sharing
+        if self.decode_uses_page_table:
+            # Keep a distinct page-table buffer for page-table decode.  Sharing
             # cuda_graph_kv_indices with non-unified token indices makes
             # page-table width ambiguous after the token buffer is expanded.
             max_num_blocks_per_seq = (
@@ -2966,14 +2974,12 @@ def _apply_cuda_graph_metadata(
             kv_last_page_len = None
             max_q_len = None
 
-            if spec_info is None or (
-                self.use_triton_unified_attention and not self.use_mla
-            ):
+            if spec_info is None or (self.decode_uses_page_table and not self.use_mla):
                 max_num_blocks_per_seq = (
                     self.max_context_len + self.page_size - 1
                 ) // self.page_size
 
-                if not self.use_triton_unified_attention:

                     kv_indptr = kv_indptr[: bs + 1]

@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+"""GSM8K on a dense, non-sliding-window model with the SHUFFLE 5D KV layout.
+
+The 5D layout decodes through ``pa_decode_gluon``, which reads ``kv_indices`` as a
+2-D page table. Sliding-window models always get that table because they force
+unified attention; a dense model at ``page_size > 1`` only gets it when the decode
+metadata follows the KV layout, so this is the configuration that guards it.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=210, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+
+class TestAiterVectorized5DDenseDecode(CustomTestCase, GSM8KMixin):
+    gsm8k_accuracy_thres = 0.7
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls._env_stack = contextlib.ExitStack()
+        cls._env_stack.enter_context(envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.override(True))
+        cls._env_stack.enter_context(
+            envs.SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.override("vectorized_5d")
+        )
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=["--attention-backend", "aiter", "--page-size", "64"],
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+        cls._env_stack.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
